assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction with precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied ORIGINAL product photograph. Produce a cleaned photographic cutout of the EXACT SAME physical object. Remove only the white background and all printed branding, model lettering and tiny compliance writing from the existing rear black tube. Fill those printed areas with matching original black surface. Lock the entire geometry and camera view: same very slim tall cylindrical black light wand, same visible unlit rear face, same top faceted cap, same long vertical grooves, same lower embedded controller with small screen/buttons, same bottom collar, same three miniature tripod feet in their original arrangement including long front foot. Keep all non-text hardware and edges in exactly their original relative positions and proportions. Do not rotate the product; do not reveal its unseen illuminated front; do not redesign, add lights, handles, new tripod or panels. Preserve the natural photography and subtle existing material shading, only improve clarity of the existing photograph. Entire product in frame, centered with modest margin, no crop. Output real transparent alpha background. No text, logo, branding, package, scenery, shadow background, watermark or extra accessories.
assets.qa: Accepted after visual comparison against original source: source view, silhouette, hardware and lighting preserved; visible printing and background removed. RGBA alpha range verified 0–255.
